statements.t: “We have considerable momentum across our business and will be exiting 2026 in the strongest position in Range’s history.

With EQT, we will have improved market access, best-in-class inventory, enhanced cash flow generation, and fortified resiliency to drive profitable growth and shareholder value creation through commodity cycles.
We look forward to completing the transaction and unlocking its compelling benefits for our team, customers, partners and shareholders.”

risks.t: the possibility that shareholders of EQT may not approve the issuance of EQT shares required in the proposed transaction
the possibility that the shareholders of Range may not adopt the Merger Agreement
the risk that the parties may not be able to satisfy the conditions to the proposed transaction in a timely manner or at all
risks related to disruption of management’s time from ongoing business operations due to the proposed transaction
the risk that any announcements relating to the proposed transaction could have adverse effects on the market price of EQT’s or Range’s common stock
the risk of any unexpected costs or expenses resulting from the proposed transaction
the risk of any litigation relating to the proposed transaction
the volatility in commodity prices for crude oil and natural gas
the risk that the credit ratings of the combined business may be different from what EQT and Range expect
the ability of management to execute its plans to meet its goals and other risks inherent in EQT’s and Range’s businesses
public health crises and any related government policies and actions
the combined company’s ability to identify and mitigate the risks and hazards inherent in operating in the global energy industry
